'''Port Epsilon''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the city [[Oluna Biqua]], on [[Genarius]].

==History==
Port Epsilon was a covered port and was used as Oluna Biqua's emergency port and to bring in hazardous materials or anything else that was unsuitable for the normal landing bays. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled to Oluna Biqua aboard the [[YT-1220]] ''[[Headliner]]'' and it was ordered to land in Port Epsilon. The [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Ti-Ori Tamun]] and twelve members of the [[Oluna Biqua Elite Guard]] met them there.
